display.purpose: Seat heading in the detail panel; uppercase, 800, expanded Archivo.

headline.purpose: Screen and panel headings and the wordmark; uppercase, 800, expanded.

title.purpose: Sentence-case dialog and card titles that are not place names.

body.purpose: Descriptions, lists and helper copy; 16px in mobile inputs.

label.purpose: Small uppercase signage labels: subtitle, section labels, location line, field captions.

data.purpose: Geist Mono tabular figures for counts, times and the alias.

shadows.name: hairline-lift
shadows.purpose: Barely raised card such as the login panel.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Small floating controls such as the map zoom stack and toggles.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Mobile bottom sheets lifted over the map only.

motion.name: ease-out-settle
motion.purpose: Sheet settle after drag and status-strip scale.

motion.name: press
motion.value: translateY(1px); scale(0.98) on large buttons, scale(0.96) on chips

motion.name: status-strip
motion.purpose: Proportional occupancy strip under the status board.

motion.name: seat-pulse
motion.purpose: Ring pulse on your seat and on open disputes (map only).

motion.name: seat-spot
motion.purpose: Ripple around the selected seat (map only).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables every loop, the sheet entrance, the strip transition and press offsets.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width main seat action ("Estoy acá") with an optional tabular time hint.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary); color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-btn-primary-hint { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered surface button for secondary actions such as signing out or Google sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Tonal, borderless dismissal button at the foot of sheets ("Ahora no").
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--border); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline-bordered surface field used in login and forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font-size: 16px; caret-color: var(--primary); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-faint); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Nav
components.description: Mobile tab bar; the active tab gets a teal icon and a short teal plate bar on its top edge.
components.css: .ds-tabnav { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex: 1; min-height: 48px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 0 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-bar { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; height: 3px; width: 0; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px; background: var(--primary); transition: width 0.2s; } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] svg { color: var(--primary); } .ds-tab[aria-current="page"] .ds-tab-bar { width: 32px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Bordered 10px panel; Chalk Surface for primary content, Slate Wash for secondary panels like the donation card. Heading in signage caps.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display), Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 118%; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.css: .ds-chips { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-chip { display: flex; min-height: 56px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 4px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); overflow: hidden; } .ds-board > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; padding: 10px 4px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-board > div:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-swatch { width: 20px; height: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-board dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); } .ds-board dt { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Alias Ticket
components.description: The donation alias as a dashed tear-off ticket; tapping anywhere copies it.
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-ticket:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-ticket:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ticket-text { display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-ticket-label { font-family: var(--font-display), Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 112%; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-ticket-alias { font-family: var(--font-mono), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); } .ds-ticket-tag { display: flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-ticket:hover .ds-ticket-tag { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: The Seat
components.description: Signature map seat: top-down chair with backrest, wooden frame and a state-filled cushion carrying its state letter; dashed teal ring on keyboard focus, slow glow when free, pulsing ring on your own seat.

components.css: .ds-seat { overflow: visible; } .ds-seat-btn { cursor: pointer; outline: none; } .ds-seat-focus { opacity: 0; } .ds-seat-btn:focus-visible .ds-seat-focus { opacity: 1; } .ds-seat-glow { animation: ds-seat-glow 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-seat-pulse { animation: ds-seat-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-seat-glow { 0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0)); } 50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.55)); } } @keyframes ds-seat-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; stroke-width: 2; } 50% { opacity: 0.9; stroke-width: 3.5; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seat-glow, .ds-seat-pulse { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The room is drawn as wayfinding signage: a building plan you can read in seconds. Everything on screen behaves like the plates, door signs and boards of a real study hall. Table names sit on dark plates over oak tabletops, the entrance carries a marker, headings are set in expanded uppercase capitals, and the counts on the status board never jitter. The interface around the map stays quiet so the map and its seat states do the talking.

The mood is calm, functional, institutional-but-unofficial, and honest about freshness. It borrows the clarity of public signage without borrowing any institution's identity. Density is moderate and phone-first: one column of plain, tactile, signposted controls on mobile; three columns on desktop with the map in the centre. Light mode is cool graphite ink on a grey-green "pizarra clara" paper; dark mode is the same layering at night, a near-black green with lifted teal.

Color is rationed. One petrol-teal accent drives action and focus; the only saturated palette belongs to seat state, and state is never told by color alone. The one place the system becomes illustrative is the room itself: oak tables, wooden chairs with backrests, terracotta floor, windows and wall bars. That warmth stays inside the map. Navy and cream UI paper are rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Grey-green paper, graphite ink, one petrol-teal accent.
Saturated hues only for seat state, always paired with a word, letter or count.
Expanded uppercase Archivo for place names and screen headings, like signage plates.
Tabular mono figures for counts, times and the donation alias.
Flat tonal layering at rest; the strong shadow is reserved for sheets lifted over the map.
Tight, signage-like corners (5 to 12px), never soft pills except avatars, dots and the entrance marker.
Motion is transform and opacity only; the only loops live on seats.

rules.name: The State Palette Rule
rules.body: Green, red, amber, yellow and mauve exist only to report seat state: on seats, counters, legend swatches, status pills and observation chips. They are never decoration, never a brand color, never a section tint.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Pizarra Teal is the only accent. If a second thing on the screen needs emphasis, use weight, size or a Slate Wash fill, not a new hue.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state color travels with a word, a letter or a number: the seat letter (L, O, ?, G, -), the status pill label, the counter caption, the chip text. Color lives in the dot or swatch; the text stays ink so it keeps full contrast.

rules.name: The Signage Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase extrabold expanded Archivo is for names of places and screens, the things a sign would say. Body copy, buttons and messages stay sentence case.

rules.name: The Steady Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates live (counts, times, durations) uses tabular figures so the board never jitters.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: A card that sits in the page flow gets a border and a tonal step, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Lifted Sheet Rule
rules.body: The upward sheet shadow is used only by bottom sheets that rise over the map; nothing else casts upward.

dos: **Do** keep the UI on Pizarra Paper, Chalk Surface and Slate Wash with Graphite Ink text; step depth by tone and a 1px hairline.
**Do** use Pizarra Teal for the one primary action per view, the active nav marker, focus and selection.
**Do** pair every seat-state color with its label, letter or count, and keep that text in ink.
**Do** set place and screen names in uppercase extrabold expanded Archivo, and everything else in sentence case.
**Do** use Geist Mono tabular figures for counts, times and the alias.
**Do** keep corners between 5px and 12px, with 22px only on the top edge of bottom sheets.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more and primary actions at 48 to 56px.
**Do** animate with transform and opacity only, and switch every loop off under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use seat-state colors for decoration, icons, section tints or brand moments.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue, navy, or cream UI paper. Warm wood and cream tones belong to the room illustration only.
**Don't** set body copy, buttons or messages in uppercase signage caps.
**Don't** put shadows on in-flow cards, or the upward sheet shadow on anything but a bottom sheet over the map.
**Don't** add looping animation outside the seats on the map.
**Don't** use soft pill shapes for buttons or cards; full rounding is for avatars, dots and the entrance marker.
**Don't** use the UNS logo, crest or institutional colors.
